question: Measure phi (share of sponsor labour cost spent on grant-processing processes P01-P15) for community foundations and $1-10bn nationals from job descriptions/org charts, CF annual reports and staffing pages (grants-management FTE vs total FTE), replacing the assumed triangular(0.05,0.15,0.35)
